summary.text: Black Hair Kingdom is the mortal polity on Black Hair Continent in Lang Ya blessed land, ruled by Black Hair King from its capital and imperial city.

claims.text: No chapter describes the capital’s streets or walls beyond naming Black Hair Kingdom’s capital and imperial city on Black Hair Continent.

Black Hair King rules from the imperial city on Black Hair Continent. After the Cloud Cover Continent immortal miracle, he decrees a martial competition, and the order spreads outward from the imperial city.
The kingdom sits among other kingdoms on the three sea continents; Black Hair King worries that a human winner would make his kingdom the laughing stock of the other two kingdoms.

At the capital of Black Hair Kingdom, the first national martial contest reaches its final. Black Hair King watches from a raised platform and has already tampered with the battle so a human Gu Master will not take first place easily. Fang Yuan’s will tells Fang Zheng that Black Hair Kingdom’s higher ups will not let him win so easily, and that the contest is a tool for those in power. Fang Zheng still wins first, and Fang Yuan notes that this causes Black Hair Kingdom to lose face. Fang Yuan then sends an enormous will that divides above Black Hair Continent, with one part flying toward Black Hair Kingdom’s capital and the other toward Steel Thread City.
